props.gloss_en: the mishna: the hide, the rotev, the kifa ... join to make [food] impure with food impurity
Rava: the mishna's rotev is shumna (fat)
Abaye: rather, rotev is fat that congealed
Reish Lakish: brine on a vegetable joins [with it] to make up the large-date measure on Yom Kippur
there [Yom Kippur] it is because of settling the mind, and with any amount his mind is settled
here it is because of combining: if [the fat] congealed, it joins
if it did not congeal, it does not join (the prop is 'uncongealed fat joins', which the stam DENIES)

objections.gloss_en: אמר ליה אביי: הוא עצמו יטמא טומאת אוכלין -- [shumna] itself would become impure with food impurity
